column1: # Roadmap MC.7: the MP.3 slices against their originals, measured 2026-11-18 with ./gradlew :engine-desktop:perfBaseline -PperfScenes=... (same machine and settings as docs/performance/baseline-windows.tsv)
# Forgeroom performance baseline (roadmap M9.5); medians of 3 run(s) per scene, 330 frames each, the first 30 not measured
# Machine: Windows 11 10.0 amd64, 8 processors; Java 21.0.11; the GPU is in each row
# Frame times wait for the GPU to finish (glFinish), so vsync does not hide them; heap is the Java heap only, not native memory
